slides.kicker: WAYMO'S ANNOUNCED MARKETS OUTSIDE THE US
slides.headline: Seven countries outside the US have a public Waymo plan today; this deck covers them plus every Latin American market.
columns: Local methods and wallets through Yuno
rows: London: commercial service planned for 2026, timing tied to UK approval; Moove runs fleet operations
Bacs direct debit · Klarna · Clearpay · Trustly · Apple Pay · +2 more
Tokyo: driverless commercial service targeted for 2027 with Nihon Kotsu and GO, subject to permits
7-Eleven · PayPay · Konbini (FamilyMart, Lawson, Ministop, Seicomart) · Pay-easy · Apple Pay · +2 more
Munich: testing from late 2026, public launch targeted for the end of 2027, federal permit pending
SEPA Direct Debit · EU bank transfer · Trustly · Apple Pay · Google Pay
Madrid: Waymo Iberia SL registered, testing before the end of 2026, no launch date announced
SEPA Direct Debit · Klarna · EU bank transfer · Trustly · Apple Pay · +2 more
Announced September 2026 with MOT and LTA: manual driving in 2027, ride-hailing launch in 2028 subject to approvals
DANA · Atome · GrabPay · Apple Pay · Google Pay · +1 more
Toronto: first riders targeted for 2028, Element Fleet Management runs the fleet
Klarna · Afterpay · Trustly · PAD direct debit · Apple Pay · +2 more
Talks with the federal, NSW and Victoria governments reported in January 2026; no permit application filed
Klarna · Afterpay · Zip · Apple Pay · Google Pay · +1 more
slides.note: Public announcements as of 22 October 2026. No other country has an announced Waymo launch. Providers live = connections available through Yuno in that country.
slides.notes: Market status sources: Waymo blog (London, Oct 2025), CNBC (Munich, 25 Aug 2026), The Olive Press (Madrid, 25 Aug 2026), Fortune and LTA (Singapore, 17 Sep 2026), Element Fleet and TipRanks (Toronto, 2028), Nihon Kotsu and GO (Tokyo 2027), AFR via ACS (Australia, Jan 2026). Sources: y.uno/integrations directory (export of 14 Oct 2026), docs.y.uno Payment Type list and API enums (22 Oct 2026), Yuno integration code scan (Caio Freitas, 14 Oct 2026); Payments Concierge integration matrix for the Latin American markets; Apple Pay availability per Apple (22 Oct 2026). Live = the connection is built and available to process through Yuno for this country; method activation is set per merchant.
